label: Online community building
summary: Online community building appears in Maaike's work as a practice that grew out of the disruption caused by COVID lockdowns. It became part of how she shaped and redefined her freelance business, Convocat, sitting alongside conversation design as a core activity. The two areas seem to have informed each other as she built her independent career.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike frames community building as something that helped her reshape and redefine her core business after COVID. It is mentioned as a direct consequence of the lockdown period and is positioned as one of two main professional identities she developed as a freelancer, the other being conversation design. Beyond that framing, the passage does not go into detail about specific methods or approaches she uses.
open_questions: How exactly did COVID lockdown lead Maaike to take up online community building, and what form did that work take in practice?
